Name: Pebble's Cellar
Author: PebbleQuest
Description: I always thought the cellar looked a little drab, and I wanted it to act more as a cozy basement. This mod doesn't [i]functionally [/i]change the cellar, it just makes it a bit cuter. There's a few pieces of flavour text just for fun, and to make it feel a bit more lived in.

Downloads.Description: Changes to update keys, as I no longer post my mods on ModDrop or GitHub.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Pebble's Cellar
Manifest.Description: A cute little cellar where you can chill.
